title: using the output option "sourcemapPathTransform: () => {}"  causes a TypeError that points to a rollup script
body:

- Rollup Version: 2.3.3
- Operating System (or Browser): MacOs Catalina
- Node Version (if applicable): v13.12.0
- Link to reproduction (IMPORTANT, read below): https://repl.it/@KilianKilmister/TremendousWoodenQuadrants

<!--
  Issues without minimal reproductions will be closed! Please provide a link to one by:
  1. Using the REPL at https://rollupjs.org/repl/, or
  2. Using the REPL.it reproduction template at https://repl.it/@rollup/rollup-repro

  reproduction not only "proves" your bug to us but also allows us to spend all our effort
  fixing the bug instead of struggling to understand your issue.
-->


### Expected Behavior
Rollup raising an error that mentions the invalid option chosen

### Actual Behavior
Undescriptive TypeError:
```js
TypeError: Cannot read property 'indexOf' of undefined
    at normalize (/Users/USER/dev/QuestJS/node_modules/rollup/dist/shared/rollup.js:6565:14)
    at /Users/USER/dev/QuestJS/node_modules/rollup/dist/shared/rollup.js:15829:61
    at Array.map (<anonymous>)
```

Note: `output.sourcemap`must be set to true aswell 
was a bitch to track this one down. Hopefully this will save some people some trouble
